_doc: Pinned model for every headless agent call (engine/agent_call.py). An agent uses "default" unless its file names another model ("inherit" or no model means the default). Evaluation reports record this model and the CLI version; a change makes earlier reports stale for locking (evals/run_evals.py stale). claude_command: the CLI as an argument list. discrimination_model (T1.4): the weaker model a new suite runs on once (evals/run_evals.py --discrimination; suite design rule 5); its reports never count for locking and never make other reports stale or current.
